title: Bulk confirmation shows the count, and the result lists any failures
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. Enough parts to select several; a way to make some fail (e.g. one already changed).
custom_steps:
1. Select more than one part and open the confirmation; read the stated count.
  2. Confirm a bulk change where some parts fail.
  3. Read how many succeeded, how many failed, and each failed part's name and reason.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When the action covers more than one part the confirmation states how many parts are selected; after a bulk change the system shows how many parts succeeded and how many failed, naming each failed part and its reason.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
